subject_patterns: Permission Protocol + {company} — the missing enforcement layer
structure: 1. Hook: Reference their specific agent use case or incident (1 sentence)
2. Problem: Name the gap — no external gate between agent decision and action (2 sentences)
3. Solution: PP authorization receipts, specific to THEIR use case (2-3 sentences)
4. Proof: NIST submission, open-source SDKs, specific technical detail (1-2 sentences)
5. Ask: 15-minute call, not 'let me know if interested' (1 sentence)
1. One provocative question about THEIR specific agent risk
2. One sentence: what we built (no jargon)
3. permissionprotocol.com — nothing else
